item.title: UN nuclear chief warns strike near Iran reactor risks crossing ‘reddest line’
item.summary: UN nuclear watchdog warns projectile strike near Iran's Bushehr nuclear plant crosses "reddest line" of nuclear safety as regional conflict intensifies.

item.title: Afghanistan accuses Pakistan of killing hundreds in Kabul hospital strike
item.summary: Reported airstrike on Afghanistan hospital allegedly kills 400+ civilians, sparking widespread criticism over muted international response to the attack.

item.title: Trey Yingst visits site of Iranian cluster missile attack that killed 2 Israelis
item.summary: Iranian cluster munition strike near Tel Aviv reportedly killed at least two civilians, damaging homes and buildings. The IDF says cluster bombs challenge Israel's defense systems.

item.title: Lone wolf attackers pose most likely terror threat to US homeland, intelligence report reiterates
item.summary: The 2026 U.S. threat assessment highlights lone wolf extremists as the primary terrorism risk, with online radicalization fueling attacks.

item.title: TSA warns of security 'threat' as airport checkpoint closures trigger more travel delays
item.summary: The DHS shutdown has created travel chaos for flight passengers as a Philadelphia airport closes security checkpoints. Long wait times are reported at major airports amid the crisis.

item.title: Restaurant owner could 'go broke' under blue state's proposed to-go packaging ban, he warns
item.summary: Connecticut lawmakers consider banning polystyrene takeout packaging by 2028, joining California and New York in restricting Styrofoam containers.

item.title: Former Assad-era prison chief convicted of torture in US federal court, marking a historic first
item.summary: Samir Ousman Alsheikh, a former Syrian prison chief, was found guilty of torture and immigration fraud charges, becoming the first Assad-era official convicted in a U.S. court.

item.title: One dead after cable car detaches, plummets at Swiss ski resort
item.summary: A 61-year-old woman died Wednesday after a gondola detached and crashed on a snowy mountainside in Engelberg, Switzerland, authorities said.

item.title: 'Bachelorette' star Taylor Frankie Paul says domestic violence allegations feel 'like the end of the world'
item.summary: "The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives" star Taylor Frankie Paul opens up about "heavy" domestic violence accusations, prioritizing her children amid the intense public scrutiny.

item.title: College track and field athlete Matthew Wing, 22, killed in wrong-way crash in Missouri
item.summary: College track athlete Matthew Wing was killed in a wrong-way collision on Interstate 49 in Missouri Friday, according to online records. The university confirmed his death Tuesday.
